## Risk and privacy

- [ ] I added or updated focused tests.
- [ ] I ran formatting, lint, and typechecking for the changed packages.
- [ ] I did not add prompts, completions, raw paths, tool arguments, or raw session identifiers.
- [ ] Measured and modelled values remain distinguishable.
- [ ] Runtime hook changes fail open.
- [ ] UI screenshots and fixtures contain synthetic data only.
- [ ] I documented any compatibility, migration, or policy-output change.
